meaning:
Baal-peor = "lord of the gap"
the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites
Another name of ba.al (בַּעַל "Baal" H1168A)

elsewhere.note: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.
Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.
They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
